controls.conditions: B1/B2/B3 retain distinct identities, exposure classes and common analysis definitions.
Same material classes and metric definitions, separate program histories; do not assume paired historical samples.
Observe target joint and protected neighbors before/after; local control is not established by a global silhouette.
Keep material, hinge orientation, axis datum and imposed-strain definitions separate.
Current measured temperature and equilibration evidence must accompany each configuration.
Track incidental UV and do not apply automatic post-cure.
Own-specimen baseline geometry, instrument calibration and actual condition readbacks precede analysis.
Keep failed cycles, residual deformation and exposure history; selected checkpoint photographs do not prove all cycles.

replication: Only the hinge-angle error bars state five experimental results. Ten and forty refer to repeated cycles, not independent specimen counts.
